title: NumericRefinementList and Range distinction
body:
Our NumericRefinementList has it's own namespace while this is a Range with multiple start/end values and a possible multiple/single element selected behavior.

I don't know yet how to make this easier. I find it weird that we have both NumericRefinementList and Range. A NumericRefinementList is a Range dealing with multiple ranges. So we either have a naming issue or we need to merge them.

Maybe we can just rename NumericRefinementList to MultiRange?

comments.body:
~~Also add `multiselect={false}` to allow selecting only one value. By default you should be able to select multiple of them.~~ No longer a priority, maybe later

Also visually indicate non-relevant ranges given the current faceting stats.
The multiselect option is no longer a priority for the first react-instantsearch release.
